limitations: Nearest cloth vertex/edge-midpoint/face-centroid to physical teddy-triangle samples are not exact continuous triangle-triangle contact onset.
First-near statements are bounded by these20 frames, not every0.05s native observation.
Native right link7 includes welded palm; right fingers also touch the bear by design. Per-link soft contact forces do not identify which soft entity or contact patch generated each load.
Signed physical-body normals are meaningful locally away from seams; strap normal has no bag inside/outside meaning.
Chronological coincidence supports but does not prove a unique contact mechanism.
